answer: Network diversity cap. Each hosting provider may hold at most 5 percent of payout weight per epoch. In a jade trading guild, every member posts a 20 POA bond and proves a network origin. One fake costs 20 POA plus a server; 10 fakes on one provider share one 5 percent slice, bonds 200 POA; 100 fakes lock 2000 POA for that same slice. Honest users pay once. A dune of cheap servers in one data center earns nothing extra. Nectar vendors supplying random latency probes check origins; a failed claim slashes 50 percent. Limit: attackers renting many providers can still pay in.
